classification: prospective engineering fidelity gate after q8 failures; not a confirmatory relevance experiment
purpose: Determine whether the pinned fp16 browser export reproduces the frozen PyTorch embedding space and can drive the unchanged static compressed-index design.

lineage.only_runtime_change_from_v1: browser ONNX dtype changes from q8 to fp16
lineage.known_tradeoff: the pinned fp16 ONNX payload is 1200510818 bytes before browser-cache overhead

fixed_design.prototype_sample_method: uniform deterministic vector-id stride over the frozen corpus
fixed_design.document_quantization: symmetric signed int8 with fixed scale 127 after L2 normalization
fixed_design.cluster_training_method: uniform deterministic vector-id stride over the frozen corpus

decision_rule.pass: Every applicable gate passes without changing the fixed design.
decision_rule.fail: Any applicable gate fails. Stop v3 without tuning.
decision_rule.continuation_if_pass: Build immutable full-corpus static shards and metadata, validate hashes and real-browser retrieval, and document the greater-than-1-GiB cold-start tradeoff before any default-off integration.
decision_rule.continuation_if_fail: Close the current browser-Qwen3 path and keep the server-backed alpha plus traditional-search fallback unchanged.

prohibitions: No production changes in this experiment.
No changes to src/core/rank.js or existing retrieval.
No human relevance labels during construction or inference.
No model weights committed to Git.
No modification of frozen FAISS, embeddings or prior benchmark artifacts.
No post-hoc parameter tuning within v3.
